text: “No, I did not drop it. You say he found it in that clump of trees?” “Well, I assumed so, but he did not actually say so.” “It is just possible that it might have fluttered out of M. Isaacstein’s suit-case. Question Boris again.” He handed the paper back to Anthony. After a minute or two he said: “What exactly do you know of this man Boris?” Anthony shrugged his shoulders. “I understood he was the late Prince Michael’s trusted servant.” “It may be so, but make it your business to find out.
